Good morning, everyone. Let me start with the numbers for the third quarter. Total sales increased by eight percent. That is good. In Brazil, we reached ninety-six percent of the target. In Argentina, we reached ninety percent. Together, that is ninety-four percent. So we didn't reach the target, but we are close. The main problem was August: prices dropped, and two customers delayed their orders. The good news is our market share. It increased from eighteen to twenty percent. And we signed one new contract. Fernanda, thank you for that. Now, questions?

Hi, I am Giulia, and I work with car makers in Italy. My quarter was not easy. In July, everything started well. We signed two small contracts, and sales increased. But in August, many factories in Italy closed for the summer holidays, so orders dropped a lot. In September, we worked very hard and we visited six customers. In the end, we reached one hundred and two percent of the target. I was very happy. What did I learn? I learned to plan August in June.
